headline: Kyle Shanahan on Nick Bosa's injury: I know he's bummed, but he'll be back
summary: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan confirmed defensive end Nick Bosa will miss multiple weeks after injuring his calf before Thursday's practice.

headline: Jayden Daniels avoids IR after elbow injury
summary: Ian Rapoport shares encouraging news on Jayden Daniels' elbow injury, with the Commanders hopeful their quarterback will return sooner rather than later.

headline: Bears ST coach says Eagles are violating intent of the rule by using holder on kickoffs
summary: Last week, the Eagles used a holder on their kickoffs so that the ball could be placed at an angle that affected the trajectory of the ball and made it harder for the returner to field.
